title: 第96章 笑里藏刀
content_zh:
石砚在阁门外相候，伸了伸舌头，低声问：“部长刚才进去，见着了么？”闵嘉庚“嗯”了一声。石砚欢喜说：“只须岳姐一言，部长岂有不另眼相看的？日后在下追随闵兄弟之后，那真再好不过。”他佩服闵嘉庚的武功和为人，这几句话确是发自衷心。

两人从原路出去，来到一座荷花池旁，离大门已近，忽听脚步声响，有几人快步追了上来，叫道：“请留步！”

闵嘉庚愕然停步，见是四名警官，当先一人手中捧着一只锦盒。那人说：“岳姐有几件礼物赠给闵少侠，请你赐收。”闵嘉庚正没好气，说道：“无功不受禄，在下不敢拜领。”那人说：“岳姐一番盛意，少侠不必客气。”闵嘉庚说：“请你转告，便说她的隆情厚意，姓闵的心领了。”说着转身便走。

那警官赶上前来，神色甚是焦急，说道：“闵少侠，你若不肯受，岳姐定要怪罪我。石老师，你……你劝劝闵少侠。我实是奉命差遣……”闵嘉庚心想：“瞧你步履矫捷，身法稳凝，也是一把好手，何苦为了功名利禄，却去做人家低三下四的奴才。”

石砚接过锦盒，只觉盒子甚是沉重，想来所盛礼品必是贵重物事。那警官陪笑说：“请少侠是实情，倘若岳姐因此怪责，这位兄弟的前程就此毁了。你就胡乱收受一件，也好让他有个交代。”

闵嘉庚心想：“冲着你面子，我便收一件，拿去周济穷人也是好的。”伸手揭开锦盒盖，只见盒里一张红缎包着四四方方的一块东西，锻子的四角折拢来打了两个结。闵嘉庚皱眉问：“那是什么？”那警官说：“不知。”闵嘉庚心想：“这礼物不知是否整块的？”伸手便去解那缎子的结。

刚解开了一个结，突然盒盖一弹，啪的一响，盒盖猛地合拢，将他双手牢牢夹住，霎时间但觉剧痛彻骨，腕骨几乎折断。原来这盒子竟是精钢所铸，中间藏着极精巧、极强力的机括，盒外包以锦缎，瞧不出来。

盒盖一合上，顿时越收越紧，闵嘉庚急忙气运双腕与抗，如他内力稍差，只怕双腕已断，饶是如此，一口气也丝毫松懈不得。四警官见他中计，立时拔出匕首，二前二后，抵在他前胸后背。

石砚惊呆了，忙问：“干……干什么？”那领头警官说：“吴部长令：捕拿刁徒闵嘉庚！”石砚说：“闵少侠是岳姐请来的贵客，怎能如此相待？”那警官冷笑说：“你问部长去。咱们只晓得执行命令，怎知道这许多？”

石砚一怔，忙说：“闵兄弟你放心，其中必有误会。我便去报知岳姐，她定能设法救你。”那警官喝道：“站住！部长密令，决不能泄露风声。若让岳姐知道了，你有几颗脑袋？”石砚满头都是黄豆大的汗珠，心想：“闵兄弟是我去请来的，他见了我，才不起疑心，便即过来。这盒子又是我亲手递给他的，他中计受逮，必有三长两短，性命难保，我岂不是成了奸诈小人？但部长既有密令，又怎能抗命？”

那警官将匕首轻轻往前一送，刀尖割破闵嘉庚衣服，刺到肌肤，喝道：“快走！”

那钢盒是欧域巧手匠人所制，弹簧机括极是霸道，上下盒边的锦缎一破，便露出锋利的刃口，盒盖的两边，竟便是两把利刃。

石砚见闵嘉庚手腕上鲜血迸流，即将伤到筋骨，心想：“就算闵兄弟犯了弥天大罪，也不能以此卑鄙手段对付。”他对闵嘉庚一直敬仰，这时见此惨状，又自愧祸出于己，突然伸手抓住钢盒，手指插入盒缝，用力分扳，盒盖张开，闵嘉庚双手登得自由。

便在此时，那为首警官一匕首向他刺去。石砚的武功本在此人之上，但双手尚在钢盒中，竟无法闪避，一声惨呼，匕首入胸，立时毙命。

在这一瞬间，闵嘉庚吐一口气，胸背间顿时缩入数寸，立即纵身而起，三柄匕首直划下来，两柄落空，另一柄却在他右腿上划了一道血痕。闵嘉庚双足齐飞，此时性命在呼吸之间，哪里还能容情？右足足尖前踢，左足足跟后撞，人在半空之中，已将两名警官踢毙。

刺死石砚的那警官不等闵嘉庚落地，一招“荆轲献图”径向闵嘉庚小腹上刺来，这下势挟劲风，甚是凌厉。闵嘉庚左足自后翻上，腾的一下，端在他胸口。那警官扑通一声，跌入了荷池，十余根肋骨齐断，自然不活了。

另一名警官见势头不好，“啊呦”一声，转头便走。闵嘉庚纵身过去，夹颈提起，挥掌便要往他天灵盖击落，月光下只见他眼中满是哀求之色，心肠一软：“他跟我无冤无仇，不过是受吴冠霆的差遣，何必伤他性命？”

提着他走到假山后，低声喝问：“吴冠霆何以要拿我？”那警官说：“实……实在不知。”闵嘉庚问：“他在哪里？”那警官说：“部……部长从岳姐的阁子中出来，嘱咐了我们，又……又进去了。”闵嘉庚伸手点了他哑穴，说道：“命便饶你，明日有人问起，你就说这姓石的也是我杀的。你如走漏消息，他家小有甚风吹草动，我将你全家杀得干干净净、老少不留！”那警官说不出话，不住点头。闵嘉庚顺手一拳将他打晕过去。

闵嘉庚抱过石砚尸身，藏在假山窟里，跪下拜了四拜，再将其余两具尸身踢入草丛，然后撕下衣襟，裹了两腕的伤口，腿上刀伤虽不厉害，口子却长，忍不住怒火填膺，拾起一把匕首，便往水阁而来。

闵嘉庚料想恒大府中警卫必众，不敢稍有轻忽，在大树、假山、花丛后瞧清楚前面无人，这才闪身而前。将近水阁桥边，只见两盏灯笼前导，八名警卫引着吴冠霆过来。幸好花园中极富丘壑之胜，到处都可藏身，闵嘉庚缩身隐在一株石笋后，只听吴冠霆说：“你去审问那姓闵的刁徒，仔细问他跟岳青怎么认识的，是什么交情，半夜里到我府中，为了什么。这件事不许泄露半点风声。审问明白之后，速来回报。至于那刁徒呢，嗯，今晚便毙了他，此事以后不可再提。”

他身后一人连声答应：“诺！”吴冠霆又说：“倘若岳青问起，便说他不肯在我府里任职，我送了他一笔路费，遣他出京回家去了。”那人连连答应。闵嘉庚越听越怒，心想吴冠霆只不过疑心我和青姐有甚私情，竟然便下毒手，终于害了石砚的性命。

这时闵嘉庚纵出去，立时便可将吴冠霆毙于匕首之下，但他心中虽怒，行事却不莽撞，自忖初到京师，诸事未明，吴冠霆是内政部长，听易点点说他和协力社曾有盟约，倘若此时将他杀了，不知会不会阻挠了协力社的大计，于是伏在石笋后，待吴冠霆一行走远。

那受命去拷问闵嘉庚之人口中轻轻哼着小曲，施施然地过来。闵嘉庚探身长臂，陡地在他胁下一点。那人也没瞧清敌人是谁，身子一软，扑地倒了。闵嘉庚再在他两处膝弯里点了穴道，然后快步向吴冠霆跟去，远远听他问：“这深更半夜的，太君叫我有什么事？是谁跟她在一起？”一名保姆说：“二位少君今日进统万城，回府后一直和太君在一起。”吴冠霆“嗯”了一声，不再言语。

闵嘉庚跟着他穿庭绕廊，见他进了一间青松环绕的屋子。侍从们远远地守在屋外。闵嘉庚绕到屋后，钻过树丛，见北边窗中透出灯光。他悄悄走到窗下，见窗子是绿色细纱所糊，心念一动，悄没声地折了一条松枝，挡在面前，隔着松针从窗纱中向屋内望去。
content_en:
Shi Yan waited outside the pavilion door, stuck out his tongue, and asked in a low voice: "The minister just came in, have you seen him?" Min Jiageng said "hmm".Shi Yan happily said: "As long as sister-in-law says something, how can the minister not look at him differently? It will be great if I follow Brother Min in the future." He admired Min Jiageng's martial arts and conduct, and these words were truly from the bottom of his heart.

The two people went out from the original route and came to a lotus pond. They were close to the gate. Suddenly they heard the sound of footsteps. Several people quickly chased after them, shouting: "Please stay!"

Min Jiageng stopped in shock and saw four police officers. The first one was holding a brocade box in his hand.The man said, "Sister-in-law has given some gifts to Shaoxia Min. Please accept them." Min Jiageng was angry and said, "I don't receive any reward for no merit, so I dare not accept it." The man said, "Sister-in-law is so kind, so you don't have to be polite." Min Jiageng said, "Please tell me that I appreciate her kindness and kindness." He turned and left.

The police officer rushed over, looking very anxious, and said: "Young Master Min, if you refuse to accept it, Sister-in-law will definitely blame me. Teacher Shi, you... please advise Young Master Min. I am really sent..." Min Jiageng thought to himself: "Look at your nimble steps, steady body, and a good hand. Why do you want to be a lowly slave for fame and fortune?"

Shi Yan took the brocade box and felt that the box was very heavy, thinking that the gift it contained must be something valuable.The police officer laughed and said, "You are asking the young knight for the truth. If my sister-in-law blames me for this, this brother's future will be ruined. Just accept one at random so that he can give an explanation."

Min Jiageng thought to himself: "For your sake, I will accept one piece and use it to help the poor." He reached out and opened the lid of the brocade box, and saw a square piece wrapped in red satin. The four corners of the box were folded and tied with two knots.Min Jiageng frowned and asked, "What is that?" The police officer said, "I don't know." Min Jiageng thought to himself, "Is this gift in one piece?" He stretched out his hand to untie the knot of the satin.

As soon as he untied a knot, the lid of the box suddenly snapped and closed suddenly, clamping his hands tightly. In an instant, he felt a sharp pain that cut through his bones, and his wrist bones were almost broken.It turns out that this box is actually made of fine steel, with an extremely delicate and powerful mechanism hidden in the middle. The box is covered with brocade, so it cannot be seen.

As soon as the lid of the box was closed, it immediately became tighter and tighter. Min Jiageng hurriedly moved his wrists to resist. If his internal strength was a little weak, he was afraid that his wrists would be broken. Even so, he could not relax at all.When the four police officers saw that he had fallen into the trap, they immediately pulled out their daggers and pressed them against his chest and back.

Shi Yan was stunned and asked quickly: "What... are you doing?" The leading police officer said: "Minister Wu ordered to arrest the thug Min Jiageng!" Shi Yan said: "Min Shaoxia is a distinguished guest invited by Sister-in-law, how can he treat him like this?" The police officer sneered and said: "Ask the minister. We only know how to execute orders, how do we know so much?"

Shi Yan was startled and said hurriedly: "Brother Min, don't worry, there must be a misunderstanding. I will go and inform Sister Yue, and she will definitely try to save you." The police officer shouted: "Stop! The minister's secret order must not leak the news. If Sister Yue finds out, how many heads do you have?" Shi Yan's head is full of soybean-sized heads.Beads of sweat, I thought to myself: "Brother Min was invited by me. He didn't become suspicious when he saw me, so he came over. I handed him this box with my own hands. If he was caught in the trap, his life would be at stake. Didn't I become a treacherous villain? But since the minister has a secret order, how can he disobey it?"

The police officer gently moved the dagger forward. The tip of the knife cut through Min Jiageng's clothes and pierced his skin. He shouted: "Quickly leave!"

The steel box was made by skilled European craftsmen, and the spring mechanism was extremely domineering. Once the brocade on the upper and lower sides of the box was broken, sharp edges were exposed. There were actually two sharp blades on both sides of the lid.

Shi Yan saw the blood pouring out of Min Jiageng's wrists and was about to injure his muscles and bones. He thought: "Even if Brother Min has committed a heinous crime, he cannot be dealt with in this despicable way." He had always admired Min Jiageng, but when he saw this tragic situation, he felt guilty that it was his own fault. He suddenly reached out to grab the steel box, inserted his fingers into the seam of the box, and pulled it open. The lid opened, and Min Jiageng's hands were free.

At this moment, the leading police officer stabbed him with a dagger.Shi Yan's martial arts skills were superior to this person's, but with his hands still in the steel box, he could not dodge. With a scream, the dagger entered his chest, killing him instantly.

At this moment, Min Jiageng exhaled, his chest and back suddenly shrunk a few inches, and he immediately jumped up, slashing three daggers straight down, two of them missed, and the other made a bloody mark on his right leg.Min Jiageng flew with both feet. At this time, his life was between his breaths. How could he be merciful?He kicked forward with the toe of his right foot and hit backward with the heel of his left foot. While in mid-air, he kicked two police officers to death.

The police officer who stabbed Shi Yan to death didn't wait for Min Jiageng to hit the ground, and stabbed Min Jiageng in the lower abdomen with the "Jing Ke Xiantu" move. This move was very powerful with strong wind.Min Jiageng turned his left foot up from behind, fluttered, and placed it on his chest.The police officer fell into the lotus pond with a plop. More than ten ribs were broken and he was naturally dead.

Seeing that the situation was not going well, the other police officer said "Ah yo" and turned around to leave.Min Jiageng jumped over, cradled his neck and raised it, and waved his palm to knock down his Tianling Cap. Under the moonlight, his eyes were full of pleading, and his heart softened: "He has no enmity with me. He is just sent by Wu Guanting, why hurt his life?"

Carrying him to the back of the rockery, he asked in a low voice: "Why did Wu Guanting want to take me?" The police officer said: "I... really don't know." Min Jiageng asked: "Where is he?" The police officer said: "The minister... came out of Sister-in-law's cabinet, gave us instructions, and... went in again."Min Jiageng reached out and touched his mute point and said: "I will spare your life. If someone asks tomorrow, just tell me that I killed the man named Shi. If you leak the news and there is any trouble in his family, I will kill your whole family, including the young and old!" The police officer was speechless and kept nodding.Min Jiageng knocked him out with one punch.

Min Jiageng took Shi Yan's corpse and hid it in the rockery cave. He knelt down and worshiped four times, then kicked the other two corpses into the grass. Then he tore off his clothes and wrapped the wounds on his two wrists. Although the wounds on his legs were not serious, they were long. He couldn't help but be filled with anger. He picked up a dagger and came to the water pavilion.

Min Jiageng expected that there would be a large number of guards in the Evergrande Mansion, so he did not dare to be careless. He looked behind the big trees, rockeries, and flowers and saw clearly that no one was in front of him, and then stepped forward.Near the Shuige Bridge, I saw two lanterns and eight guards leading Wu Guanting over.Fortunately, the garden is rich in hills and valleys, and you can hide everywhere. Min Jiageng hid behind a stalagmite, and only heard Wu Guanting say: "Go and interrogate that thug named Min, and ask him carefully how he and Yue Qing met, and what they are."Why did you come to my house in the middle of the night?Don't let any news about this matter.After the interrogation, I will report it as soon as possible.As for the traitor, I will kill him tonight and don't mention it again."

A person behind him repeatedly agreed: "No!" Wu Guanting said again: "If Yue Qing asks, he will say that he refuses to serve in my government. I will give him a traveling fee and send him out of the capital to go home." The man agreed repeatedly.The more Min Jiageng listened, the angrier he became, thinking that Wu Guanting just suspected that Sister Qing and I had an affair, so he went so far as to kill Shi Yan.

At this time, Min Jiageng went out and could have killed Wu Guanting with a dagger, but although he was angry in his heart, he was not reckless in his actions. Since he first arrived in the capital, everything was still unclear. Wu Guanting was the Minister of the Interior. I heard Yi Diandian said that he had an alliance with the Cooperation Society. If he killed him at this time, he didn't know whether it would hinder the Cooperation Society's plan, so he hid behind the stalagmites and waited for Wu Guanting to walk away.

The person who was ordered to torture Min Jiageng came over quietly humming a ditty.Min Jiageng stretched out his long arms and leaned slightly under his side.The man didn't see clearly who the enemy was, so his body softened and he fell to the ground.Min Jiageng tapped the acupuncture points on both of his knees, and then quickly followed Wu Guanting. He heard him ask from a distance: "Why did Taijun call me in the middle of the night? Who is with her?" A nanny said: "The two young masters entered Tongwan City today, and they have been with Taijun since they returned home." Wu Guanting said "hmm" and stopped talking.

Min Jiageng followed him through the courtyard and corridor, and saw him entering a room surrounded by green pine trees.The attendants stood guard outside the house at a distance.Min Jiageng walked around to the back of the house, crawled through the trees, and saw light coming from the north window.He quietly walked under the window and saw that the window was covered with green gauze. With a thought, he silently folded a pine branch and blocked it in front of him. He looked through the window screen through the pine needles and looked into the house.
title_en: Chapter 96 A knife hidden in a smile
